offset.tooltip: Bias. The face edits this. Min, max, reverse, curve, and smooth time are Parameter Settings.

displaySource.tooltip: Mouse = pointer target. Smoothed = Bias after Parameter Settings smooth.

polarity.tooltip: Bipolar: outs swing -Amp..+Amp. Unipolar: 0.5*Amp*(v+1), so 0..Amp (0..1 at Amp 1; Amp 0 = 0). Applies to sin and cos.

method.tooltip: Sine SSOT default = Wavetable (additive half-sine LUT 2¹⁵). Polynomial = joint quadrant poly. std::sin = full-range sandbox poly (freestanding; no libm). Taylor = short quadrant-folded Taylor (continuous at wrap).

phase.tooltip: Phase offset (cycles). Knob + Phase MOD from audio-rate sources add sample-accurately.

freq.tooltip: Hz. Parameter MOD is domain-add (base + CV). Set base 0 and wire Pitch Detector / Knob Bias for absolute Hz. Enable Bipolar in param settings for thru-zero FM (negative Hz = reverse phase).

highFreq.tooltip: Sweep start frequency (the click). Latched on each Trigger. Clamped to 50 Hz ... half the sample rate.

lowFreq.tooltip: Frequency the sweep settles toward (a tuned body). 0 = keeps falling. Latched on each Trigger.

sweepTime.tooltip: Time to fall from High Freq to Low Freq + 50 Hz. Latched on each Trigger. From Robin Schmidt's SweepKicker, RS-MET.

chirp.tooltip: Tail power of the sweep. + holds the highs longer, then drops fast. - drops fast at first, then lingers low. Acts at once. From Robin Schmidt's SweepKicker, RS-MET.

chirpShape.tooltip: Attack knee vs decay at the same tail power. + keeps the start frequency a little longer, - rounds the knee. Acts at once. From Robin Schmidt's SweepKicker, RS-MET.

wave.tooltip: Waveform family. Sine. TriSaw = triangle that morphs to saws with Wave Shape. SinFatSaw = sine-shaped TriSaw (bulging fat saws). From Robin Schmidt's SweepKicker, RS-MET.

waveShape.tooltip: Saw-down (-1) ... symmetric (0) ... saw-up (+1). No effect on Sine. From Robin Schmidt's SweepKicker, RS-MET.

phase.tooltip: Start phase offset. Trigger hard-resets the oscillator to this phase. 0 = clean start at zero. +-0.25 = starts at a peak: hard click.

decay.tooltip: Amplitude envelope: seconds to fall 60 dB (T60) after a hit. Drives the 0–1 output and the Kick level. Acts at once.

amplitude.tooltip: Kick output level. Does not scale the 0–1 output.

tune.tooltip: Rest pitch of the body. 808: low resonator (high = x1.93). 909: VCO1 (VCO2 = x1.72). Simmons: oscillator. Modal: fundamental (01) mode. FM: carrier (modulator = x1.4).

tone.tooltip: Timbre. 808: low <-> high resonator mix (panel Tone). 909: noise lowpass 2 -> 12 kHz (brighter). Simmons: noise resonant lowpass 300 Hz -> 12 kHz. Modal: strike position, centre -> edge. FM: peak FM index 0 -> 8.

snappy.tooltip: Snare-wire noise amount. 808: noise envelope level (panel Snappy). 909: level of both noise bands (panel Snappy). Simmons: noise <-> tone balance. Modal / FM: noise level.

bodyDecay.tooltip: How long the tonal body rings: seconds to fall 60 dB (T60). 808: low resonator (high 0.31x). 909: VCO1 envelope (VCO2 0.6x). Simmons: shared VCA (noise and tone). Modal: 01 mode (mode k: / ratio). FM: carrier and FM index.

snapDecay.tooltip: How long the noise rings: seconds to fall 60 dB (T60). 808 / Modal / FM: noise envelope. 909: main noise band (this is the 909 panel's Tone). Simmons: extra noise envelope inside the VCA (at or above Body Decay = stock SDS-V).

bend.tooltip: Pitch drop at the hit: starts this many octaves above Tune and falls back. 0 = stock 808. 808 / 909 / FM: ~20 ms drop (909 ~0.5 oct). Simmons: falls over half the Body Decay (1-2 oct). Modal: ~30 ms tension drop.

amplitude.tooltip: Output level. Does not scale Env.

volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…0 dB). 0 dB is unity. Default −3 dB. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

offset.tooltip: Bias. The face edits this. Min, max, reverse, curve, and smooth time are Parameter Settings.

displaySource.tooltip: Mouse = pointer target. Smoothed = Bias after Parameter Settings smooth.

inputGain.tooltip: Drive into the limiter before detect/GR. Raise to hit Threshold harder (more pump).

threshold.tooltip: Level where gain reduction starts. Lower = more compression/pump on typical program.

ratio.tooltip: How hard GR climbs above Threshold. ~4–8 = firm. ~12–20 = heavy pump.

lookaheadEnabled.tooltip: On = delay audio so GR can fall before hits (helps pump without zero-attack chatter).

lookaheadMs.tooltip: Look-ahead delay in ms when Look-ahead is On. Part of the sound (not host-compensated).

lookaheadSamples.tooltip: Extra look-ahead in samples (added to LA Time). Hidden by default.

attack.tooltip: How fast GR engages on a hit. A few ms keeps punch while still pumping.

hold.tooltip: How long gain reduction is held after it stops deepening, before Release starts. A new peak restarts the hold. 0 = release right away.

release.tooltip: How fast gain recovers after a hit — the main pump/breathe timing. Longer = slower swell back.

amplitude.tooltip: Final output trim after GR. 0…1. Lower if the bus is too hot; no autogain.
